_help: Manual changes per GitHub repo name. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Fields (all optional): hide (true keeps the repo off the site; for a fork, also skipped by npm run sync), include (true always shows a fork, even without commits of my own; run npm run sync after changing it), title, summary, group (any tab name, e.g. 'Python' or 'C / C++'; always wins over the automatic group), demo (URL, or null to remove), featured (true/false), order (number, lower comes first). Overrides always win over the synced data.
